div.head: EGu 7
div.ab: Sunnandæges cypinge gyf hwá agynne, ðolie ðæs ceapes ⁊ XII ore mid Denum ⁊ XXX scill' mid Englum.
Sunnandæges cypinge gif hwa agynne, þolie þæs ceapes ⁊ twelf orena mid Denum ⁊ XXX scill’ mid Englum.
Si quis in die dominica negociationem facere presumat, perdat ipsum captale et XII oran cum Dacis, et triginta sol. cum Anglis.
[Be freolsdæges weorcum.] [Ld] Sunnandægas cypinge gif hwa agynne, þolie þæs ceapes ⁊ twelf orena mid Denum ⁊ XXX scll' mid Englum.
Sunnandæges cypinge gif hwa agynne, þolie þæs ceapes and twelf orena mid Denum and XXX scillinga mid Englum.
If anyone proceeds to bargain on a Sunday, he shall forfeit the goods, and 12 ores [in addition] in a Danish district, and 30 shillings in an English district.
If anyone does business on a Sunday, he shall forfeit his purchases and twelve oras among the Danes and thirty shillings among the English.
(Über Feiertagsarbeiten. Ld) Wenn jemand Sonntags Kaufgeschäft vornimmt, verliere er das Kaufgut und 12 Ör bei den Dänen, beziehungsweise 30 Schill. bei den Engländern.
(Of work on feast-days. Ld) If anyone engages in trade on a Sunday, let him lose the goods and 12 ores among the Danes, or 30 shillings among the English.
